Some terms will have real external anchors (calibration, consistency, robustness under perturbation of the prompt) and some will turn out to be almost pure metaphor with no anchor available even in principle — and probably most terms are a mix, anchored in part and metaphorical in part, which is exactly why it's tempting to either over- or under-claim about them.
